en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with a two‑storey building labeled "Hotel Vel Kaptol" in the foreground, a tree‑lined road along a river with a horse‑drawn carriage, and a town with a bridge in the background. The lower margin prints the captions "Hotel »Vel Kaptol.«" and "Novi Sisak." The left margin reads "Knjiga s. Jünker, Sisak." The bottom portion is filled with handwritten cursive text and a dated note.
